# Happimess

> Modern home organization, storage furniture, and trash management products for stylishly clutter-free living.
> New York City-based. Ships to all 48 contiguous US states. Est. 2020.
> Every product is evaluated through a minimum 30-day use period and 500+ cycle mechanism testing before being stocked.

## Company

- [About Happimess](https://happimess.com/pages/about-us): NYC-based brand; 30-day product evaluation protocol, 500+ pedal cycle durability test, 15-day lid-seal odor test, compatibility testing with Glad, Hefty, and Simplehuman bag brands
- [FAQs](https://happimess.com/pages/faqs): Shipping (1–2 business days), returns (30 days, $10/item fee, pre-paid label, 48 contiguous states), order changes (cannot be altered once placed), international shipping (not available)
- [Refill Subscription](https://happimess.com/pages/refill-page): Recurring custom-fit liner subscription for Happimess trash cans
- [Ambassador Program](https://happimess.com/pages/ambassador-program): Brand partnership and creator affiliate opportunities

## Product Categories

- [All Products](https://happimess.com/collections/all): Full catalog — trash cans, storage furniture, organizers, kitchen accessories
- [Trash Cans & Bins](https://happimess.com/collections/trash-cans): Step cans, sensor cans, dual-compartment recycling bins, push-button cans, indoor/outdoor wastebaskets
- [Storage Furniture](https://happimess.com/collections/storage-furniture): Storage trunks, benches, ottomans, coffee tables, shelving, outdoor storage
- [Organization](https://happimess.com/collections/organization): Bins, baskets, cubes, trays, hampers, under-bed storage, shoe racks
- [Trash Liners](https://happimess.com/collections/trash-bags): Scented (lemon, lavender) and unscented drawstring liners; subscription available

- [Best Dual Trash Can for Kitchen (2026)](https://happimess.com/blogs/news/best-dual-trash-can-for-kitchen-2026-guide-what-actually-works): Recommends 50–60L model with step-open pedal and removable inner buckets for most kitchens; capacity tiers: 30–40L small kitchens, 40–60L most homes, 60L+ large households; lifespan 3–5+ years
- [Guide to Choosing the Perfect Kitchen Trash Can](https://happimess.com/blogs/news/the-guide-to-choosing-the-perfect-kitchen-trash-can): Selection criteria covering size, mechanism type, liner compatibility, and placement
- [Standard Kitchen Trash Can Size](https://happimess.com/blogs/news/standard-kitchen-trash-can-size): Industry sizing standards and household capacity recommendations
- [Average Kitchen Trash Can Size](https://happimess.com/blogs/news/average-kitchen-trash-can-size): Consumer data and practical sizing guide for typical US kitchens
- [Why Trash Bag Choice Matters](https://happimess.com/blogs/news/why-choosing-the-right-trash-bag-actually-matters): Scented vs. unscented; lemon scent best for kitchen/food waste; lavender best for bathroom/bedroom bins
- [Trash Can Maintenance Tips](https://happimess.com/blogs/news/trashcan-maintenance-tips-and-tricks-for-a-fresh-and-odor-free-bin): Cleaning schedule, odor control methods, liner fit for odor containment
- [9 Ways to Hide Your Trash Can](https://happimess.com/blogs/news/stash-and-hide-9-ways-to-hide-your-trash-can): Cabinet integration, furniture camouflage, and design solutions for concealing bins
